words.title: Light House Cinema plans major Smithfield expansion
words.body:
The Light House Cinema has applied for planning permission to add *two new screens* to its Smithfield venue.

The proposed screens would hold *35 and 45 people*, adding 80 seats and bringing the cinema’s total capacity to *694*. The new screens would be created by converting a neighbouring former retail unit.
words.details:
**By The Numbers**
